title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 8.7 Applications of the Normal Distribution: Apply the normal distribution to real-world scenarios.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 8.7 Applications of the Normal Distribution: Apply the normal distribution to real-world scenarios.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "8.7 Applications of the Normal Distribution", prints these objectives: "Apply the normal distribution to real-world scenarios.". The section text says: "According to the Digest of Education Statistics , composite scores on the SAT have mean 1060 and standard deviation 195, while composite scores on the ACT have mean 21 and standard deviation 5." This card reports that page.
